newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian zinc, nickel see gains, other metals steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian zinc, nickel see gains, other metals steady.

text.p: Indian zinc and nickel prices on Friday extended gains while other base metals were steady at improved level, dealers said.
Zinc rose by 50 rupees to 7,400 rupees per quintal while nickel rose by 100 rupees to 37,700 rupees per quintal amid a shortage of ready stock as well as rising global prices.

On Thursday, zinc was up by 50 rupees and nickel was up by 200 rupees per quintal. Copper was steady at 12,950 rupees, aluminium at 7,325 rupees and lead at 4,575 rupees per quintal amid restricted activity. Tin was available at the previous level of 34,300 rupees after gaining 200 rupees per quintal on Thursday.

"Trading activity remained low as major players kept to the sidelines awaiting the presentation of the budget by the finance minister this evening but sentiment was subdued on fears that the minister may reduce import duty by 5/10 percent on the base metals," said Sharad Parikh," president of Bombay Metal Exchange.
